Circle of the Land.description: Druids who guard sacred ancient knowledge tied to specific geographical terrain types.

2.name: Bonus Cantrip
2.tldr: You learn one additional druid cantrip of your choice.

2.name: Natural Recovery
2.tldr: Regain some expended spell slots during a short rest once per day.

6.name: Land's Stride
6.tldr: Move through nonmagical difficult terrain without extra movement cost and avoid plant-based hazards.

10.name: Nature's Ward
10.tldr: Become immune to poison and disease, and resistant to being charmed or frightened by elementals or fey.

14.name: Nature's Sanctuary
14.tldr: Animals and plant creatures hesitate to attack you unless you attack them first.

Circle of the Moon.description: Fierce protectors of the wild who specialize in transforming into powerful beasts.

2.name: Combat Wild Shape
2.tldr: Use Wild Shape as a bonus action and expend spell slots to heal hit points while in beast form.

2.name: Circle Forms
2.tldr: Transform into more powerful beast forms with higher challenge ratings.

6.name: Primal Strike
6.tldr: Your attacks in beast form count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity.

10.name: Elemental Wild Shape
10.tldr: Expend two uses of Wild Shape simultaneously to transform into a powerful elemental creature.

14.name: Thousand Forms
14.tldr: You can cast the Alter Self spell at will without expending spell slots.
